choices.name: Higher Power
effects: Your base ability damage is increased by 30%.
You lose access to Berserk, Death's Swiftness, Living Death, and Sunshine.

assumptions: Displayed in Builds only; gameplay effects intentionally unwired.

choices.name: True Equilibrium
effects: For each unique Blessing path you have chosen, gain:
Choosing the same Blessing path from tier 1 to 6 applies this buff once.
Choosing a mixture of 2 Blessing paths from tier 1 to 6 applies this buff twice.
Choosing a mixture of 3 Blessing paths from tier 1 to 6 applies this buff 3 times.

assumptions: Displayed in Builds only; gameplay effects intentionally unwired.

choices.name: Havoc Born
effects: Your maximum life points are reduced by 25%.
Your armour value is reduced by 25%.

excluded: Fixed non-AD damage paths that bypass the CombatModifier pipeline, such as empowered Tuska's Wrath
assumptions: The wiki page states these three modifiers without source-specific exclusions, so the damage multiplier uses the shared final post-hit pipeline for direct, damage-over-time, poison, conjure, command, proc, attached, reflected, and blessing-generated damage.
The damage multiplier stacks multiplicatively with other ordered modifiers and keeps the pipeline's intermediate floor.
Maximum life and total Armour are reduced in final derived stats; raw equipment and base values are unchanged.
Life and armour multipliers multiply with other blessing modifiers when more than one is active.
Empowered Tuska's Wrath is a fixed non-AD hit that intentionally bypasses CombatModifier values in the simulator.

reason: Wire Havoc Born from the sourced card wording. The effect page has no source-specific damage exclusions; the engine applies its shared modifier to all pipeline damage and records the fixed Tuska path as an explicit engine boundary. Life and Armour penalties resolve in derived stats without mutating equipment data.
